description: Returns the authenticated user's recent notifications from DeskMonitor (approvals, alerts, system messages). Use when the user asks 'do I have any notifications?', 'show me my alerts', 'any new messages?'. Available to all authenticated roles.

page_size.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, max 50.

name: list_notifications

notifications.description: Array of notification objects (id, title, body, createdAt, isRead)

title: My Notifications
